name: @extas/checkout
description: The checkout (S04, PR 115–126): the page's quote — the bag, the delivery charge from the resolved place, the payment choice with the prepaid reward, the wallet and the totals the customer sees (PR 115–122); the form's checks and the confirm button's state (PR 116, 123, 124); order placement with its idempotency key, the stock hold, the incomplete-checkout capture and the payment failure path (PR 125); and the thank-you page's receipt (PR 126). The order stores exactly what the page showed (SIM-F-003).
